source_or_gap: The scientific-discovery chapter governs experiments and complete attempts but lacks current comparators for end-to-end computational research, language-model-controlled physical laboratories, and multi-agent hypothesis ranking, including the search-tree denominator and evaluator-dependence obligations those systems expose.
chapter_action_policy: Update the existing scientific-discovery owner and Human Reader Unit 21; do not add a chapter or inherit source-reported results as local evidence.
merge_or_split_policy: Merge search-tree custody, evaluator-dependence graphs, paper-versus-result boundaries, and the three automation regimes into the current experimental-governance lifecycle.
boundary_decision_rationale: The sources add frontier instantiations and failure surfaces, not a new architectural owner. Planning owns proposal generation, Runtime Adapters and Embodied Agency own effects, and this chapter already owns scientific design, inference, replication, and claim ceilings.
proof_or_test_backlog: extend the experimental dossier with branch identity, parentage, pruning reason, selection policy, compute, evaluator dependencies, and human intervention
add rejecting fixtures for omitted branches, correlated reviewers presented as independent, venue acceptance presented as truth, and tool completion presented as scientific confirmation
compare generation, review, and replication routes with deliberately shared and independent dependencies
evidence_transition_precondition: a prospectively frozen benign campaign with complete search and attempt custody
positive and null controls for generator and evaluator competence
promotion_blockers: no local reproduction of any source-reported system or result
no complete natural search-tree custody campaign
no independent evaluator or replication result
the AI co-scientist evidence includes provider-reported evaluation
residuals: full internal search trees and model dependencies may not be public
venue review is noisy and institution-specific
laboratory autonomy remains configuration- and oversight-dependent
proposal quality and scientific truth remain distinct
next_action: Use the sources to deepen the existing chapter and reader unit, then retain the empirical and proof work as explicit backlog.
non_claims: does not reproduce a paper, hypothesis, chemistry, review, or laboratory result
does not authorize laboratory execution or external publication
